info.title: Multitap API
info.description: Multitap: a headless Stremio client with a remote engine. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. CORS: for an `Origin` in `MULTITAP_CORS_ORIGINS`, every response carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` with that origin and `Vary: Origin`, and an `OPTIONS` preflight to a documented path answers `204` with its methods and the `Authorization`, `Content-Type` and `Last-Event-ID` headers, without a key. No credentials mode. Other origins get no CORS headers (and `OPTIONS` gets `405`).

manifestUrl.description: The addon's transport URL, ending in `/manifest.json` (`stremio://` is read as `https://`). Secret: never returned.

id.description: Multitap's id for this addon; stable for as long as it's installed.

manifestId.description: The manifest's own `id`. Two installs of one addon can share it.

host.description: The manifest URL's hostname; the rest of the URL is secret.

state.description: `needs-configuration`: the manifest says `configurationRequired`. Such an addon is installed but skipped by every aggregated request (reported with status `needs-configuration`). Configure it on its own page, then install the resulting manifest URL.

configurationUrl.description: The addon's configuration page, `{origin}/configure`, when it is `configurable` or needs configuration; `null` otherwise. Never carries the manifest URL's secret path.

fetchedAt.description: When the cached manifest was last fetched.

refreshError.description: Set when the most recent refresh failed; the last good manifest is kept and used.

configurable.description: The addon has a configuration page (`/configure`).

configurationRequired.description: The addon does nothing until configured. Multitap keeps it installed but does not query it.

idPrefixes.description: `null` when the addon accepts every id.

status.description: `ok`: answered. `timeout`: no answer in time. `error`: failed or answered with something invalid. `circuit-open`: not asked, because it has been failing. `needs-configuration`: not asked, because its manifest says it must be configured first.

dropped.description: Items the addon sent that were invalid (or unplayable in any way) and left out.

lastUsed.description: Updated at most once a minute.

auto.description: Let Multitap rank the sources and pick.

preferBingeGroup.description: Prefer candidates with this `bingeGroup`: pass the previous episode's session `bingeGroup` to keep its release (auto-next). A strong rank bonus (`binge.matchBonus`); unplayable candidates stay unplayable, and the normal ranking is the fallback. Part of the session's identity.

extra.description: Extra properties the catalog accepts, as query parameters of `GET /v1/catalog/…`. A required one must always be given.

key.description: Grouping key. A create with the key, item, source, delivery and quality of an open session returns that session (for auto-select, `preferredLanguage` counts too).

engine.description: Engine to play on. A candidate's engine affinity wins; default `MULTITAP_SELECTION_DEFAULT_ENGINE`, else the only engine there is.

mode.description: Default `play`. `full` gets `501` until preparation is built.

readyBy.description: Preparation deadline. Gets `501` until preparation is built.

items.description: ISO 639-2 (B or T) or 639-3 code, lowercase.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred audio languages for this session, most preferred first: auto-select's ranking and the fallback for `audioTrack`. Default: the profile's audio languages (with `profileId`), else the instance's `MULTITAP_SELECTION_PREFERRED_LANGUAGE`. Part of an auto-select session's identity.

audioLanguage.description: The audio language the client wants to start with. Resolved to the session's `audioTrack` once the source is probed; not part of the identity (the media is the same).

profileId.description: The profile this playback is for. Its audio languages are the preferred languages when the request has no `preferredLanguage` (request > profile > instance default); auto-select ranks the source the profile last played for this video up (`lastSource.matchBonus`); and when the session becomes ready its source is recorded as the profile's `lastSource` for the item. An unknown profile gets `400`. Part of an auto-select session's identity. Progress is still reported separately (`POST /v1/profiles/{id}/progress`).

key.description: The key itself. Returned only here, once; Multitap stores only its hash.

tonemap.description: The engine tone maps HDR to SDR.

sessionOverrides.description: The engine accepts per-session quality and TTL overrides (upstream #25).

liveConcurrency.description: Live sessions the engine transcodes at once without stalling. Multitap warns (or, with `MULTITAP_ENGINE_ADMISSION=reject`, refuses) a new session when the engine's resolving and recently playing sessions already reach it.

defaultBitrate.description: The engine's own video bitrate in bits per second (server-go's `STREMIO_TRANSCODE_VIDEO_BITRATE`), used when a session sets none. A bitrate Multitap derives from `quality.maxHeight` never exceeds it. Absent = unknown.

address.description: Base URL of the engine, if known.

online.description: The engine answered Multitap's last health check. False before the first check. Read-only.

lastSeen.description: When the engine last answered a health check; null if never. Read-only.

proxyPasswordSet.description: Multitap holds a proxy password for this engine (`proxyPassword` on PUT). The password itself is never returned. Read-only.

address.description: Base URL of the engine, if known.

proxyPassword.description: Write-only secret: the engine's `STREMIO_PROXY_PASSWORD`, sent as `api_password` on the `/proxy/stream` URLs Multitap builds (sources with `proxyHeaders`). Omitted keeps the stored value; an empty string or null clears it. Never returned: responses carry only `proxyPasswordSet`.

info.description: The engine's probe of the source.

ItemFlags.description: Present only when flagged. `destructive`: the name or id matches the `safety` ranking settings, so playing it may trigger an action in an addon or debrid account. Auto-select never picks a flagged source; an explicitly picked one still plays.

audioLanguage.description: The audio language chosen. A session created with the profile's `profileId` and no `audioLanguage` starts with it (`audioTrack`). null = no choice.

index.description: Index into the session's `tracks.subtitles` when it was chosen; only a hint for the same source.

lang.description: The track's language as the file or the addon tags it (usually ISO 639-2): a new session matches the stored choice by it, since track indexes change with the source.

fileId.description: Multitap's subtitle file id, while that addon still offers the file (a session's `subtitles[].id`).

subtitle.description: The subtitle chosen; null = no choice (the client decides).

subtitleOffsetMs.description: Subtitle timing offset in milliseconds, at most 600000 either way (positive shows cues later). A session created for the profile starts with it on the chosen addon subtitle file (`session_subtitle_offsets`).

index.description: Index into the session's `tracks.subtitles` when it was chosen; only a hint for the same source.

fileId.description: Multitap's subtitle file id, while that addon still offers the file (a session's `subtitles[].id`).

ItemSubtitleChoice.description: `embedded` (a track of the file), `addon` (an addon subtitle) or `off` (subtitles turned off).

removed.description: Not in the library (it may still be in continue watching while `temp`).

temp.description: Added by playback rather than by the user.

sourceIdentity.description: A stable hash of the stream's identity (addon, source fields, `proxyHeaders`): the candidate `key` the same stream gets in any later source list. It doesn't expire, but a key from it only plays while a list has offered it again.

name.description: The stream's short label, as the addon gave it.

title.description: The stream's description, as the addon gave it.

bingeGroup.description: The source's `bingeGroup`: pass it as `source.preferBingeGroup` for the next episode.

lastSource.description: Multitap's addition (not a stremio-core field): the source this profile last played for the item, on the library and continue-watching lists. Its `videoId` may be an earlier episode than `state.video_id`.

audioLanguage.description: The audio language chosen. A session created with the profile's `profileId` and no `audioLanguage` starts with it (`audioTrack`). null = no choice.

playerState.description: Multitap's addition (not a stremio-core field): the profile's player choices for the item (`GET …/items/{type}/{itemId}/state`), on the library and continue-watching lists when any are stored.

timeWatched.description: Milliseconds watched of the current video.

timeOffset.description: Resume position in milliseconds; 0 = nothing to resume.

duration.description: Duration of the current video in milliseconds.

video_id.description: The last video watched (stremio-core keeps this snake_case name).

watched.description: stremio-core's serialized watched-episodes bitfield; null for items without videos.
true marks watched (one more time watched, no position to resume); false resets the watched state.

token.description: Bearer credential; it is a path segment of `mediaPath`.

subject.description: Opaque viewer id chosen by the client; used for revocation and telemetry.

mediaPath.description: Path on the media listener, depending on `delivery`: `/media/{token}/master.m3u8` for transcode, `/media/{token}/stream` for direct and remux.

mediaUrl.description: Absolute URL (`MULTITAP_MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE` + `mediaPath`); present when Multitap is configured with a public media base.

index.description: Position among the session's tracks of this kind, which is the master playlist's rendition order: the hls.js `audioTracks` / `subtitleTracks` index.

lang.description: As the file tags it (usually ISO 639-2); absent when untagged.

default.description: The file marks this track as default.

videos.description: Episodes (by season, then episode; specials last) or other videos.

addonId.description: The addon the meta came from.

addons.description: Every addon that was asked, in collection order.

id.description: The video id to ask `/v1/streams` for (`tt0903747:1:1` for an episode).

subject.description: Opaque viewer id chosen by the client; used for revocation and telemetry.

videoId.description: The video to play next, or null when there is none (a movie, or the last episode).

removed.description: Not in the library (it may still be in continue watching while `temp`).

temp.description: Added by playback rather than by the user.

name.description: The stream's short label, as the addon gave it.

title.description: The stream's description, as the addon gave it.

libraryItem.description: The profile's library item for the meta, if any.

hdr.description: Absent means SDR or unknown. Dolby Vision wins over its HDR10 fallback layer.

dvProfile.description: Dolby Vision profile, only when the release states it.

bitDepth.description: Stated, or 10 when the release is HDR.

audio.description: Main audio codec: truehd, dts-hd, dts, eac3, ac3, aac, opus, flac, mp3.

container.description: File extension, lowercase: mkv, mp4, ts, m2ts, avi, …

languages.description: Audio languages as ISO 639-2/B codes; `mul` for multi/dual audio.

cached.description: Debrid cache state when the addon says: true is instant, false needs a debrid download.

key.description: A candidate key from a source list (`SourceCandidate.key`). Keys expire with the list (`MULTITAP_STREAM_STORE_TTL_MS`); an expired one gets `409`.
The client's grouping key; creation is idempotent per key.

profileId.description: The create request's `profileId`, when it had one.

bingeGroup.description: The playing source's `bingeGroup`, once `ready`. Pass it as `source.preferBingeGroup` when creating the next episode's session to keep the release.

audio.description: Every audio track. With two or more the master has an audio rendition group (one per track, in this order) and the engine starts on the first default-marked one, else the first; with one, the audio is muxed into the video and there is nothing to select.

subtitles.description: Embedded text subtitles, one WebVTT rendition each, in this order. Image subtitles (PGS, VobSub) are not offered and not listed.

tracks.description: The audio and subtitle tracks of the playing source, once `ready`.

audioTrack.description: Index into `tracks.audio` of the track to start with: the first track in the create request's `audioLanguage`, else in its preferred languages (request, else the profile's, else the instance default), default-marked tracks first. Absent with fewer than two audio tracks or no match. The engine can't choose the default audio track, so clients select it (hls.js `audioTrack = audioTrack`).

delivery.description: How media reaches players. Fixed once `ready`.

mediaEntry.description: The file a player opens under `/media/{token}/`: `master.m3u8` for `transcode`, `stream` for `direct` and `remux`. A token response gives the full `mediaPath`.

maxHeight.description: Tallest output, in pixels. Capped at the engine's `liveMaxHeight`.

bitrate.description: Video bitrate in bits per second. Capped at `MULTITAP_SESSION_MAX_BITRATE`. A request with `maxHeight` and no `bitrate` gets one derived from the height (`MULTITAP_SESSION_BITRATE_BY_HEIGHT`, at most the engine's `defaultBitrate`), and a session's `quality` shows it.

quality.description: What the engine applied. Absent when nothing was requested or the engine has no `sessionOverrides`.

failureReason.description: Coarse reason for `failed`: an engine reason (`unsupported`, `external`, `live`, `needs-prepare`, `probe-failed`, `torrent-failed`, `engine-offline`, `engine-error`, `engine-busy`: the engine is at its torrent cap; try again shortly) or a session one (`no-candidates`, `only-flagged`: every playable source is flagged `destructive` and auto-select skips those, `candidates-exhausted`, `attempts-exhausted`, `interrupted`, `internal-error`).

tokenEpoch.description: Bumped by revoke-all; tokens minted under an older epoch stop working.

lastAccess.description: Last media request or session read.

in.description: Request part: param, query, json, header

audioLanguage.description: Preferred audio language. Multitap uses it (with `secondaryAudioLanguage`) as the preferred languages of a source list or session that names this profile, after the request's own `preferredLanguage` and before the instance's `MULTITAP_SELECTION_PREFERRED_LANGUAGE`, and for the session's `audioTrack`. null (the default here, unlike stremio-core's `eng`) = the instance default.

subtitlesLanguage.description: Preferred subtitle language (for clients choosing a track).

secondarySubtitlesLanguage.description: ISO 639-2 (B or T) or 639-3 code, lowercase.

bingeWatching.description: stremio-core's auto-play of the next episode. Stored for clients: Multitap never starts the next episode itself (use `GET …/next/…` and `source.preferBingeGroup`).

nextVideoNotificationDuration.description: How long before the end to offer the next episode, ms.

client.description: Opaque settings of the profile's clients (any JSON, at most 16384 bytes). Multitap stores them and never reads them.

settings.description: Every setting: the stored ones over the defaults.

client.description: Merged key by key into the stored bag; a key set to null is removed. The merged bag must stay within the size limit.

ProfileSettingsPatch.description: Any subset of `ProfileSettings`; unknown fields are rejected.

videoId.description: The video playing; absent for a movie (the meta id is used).

event.description: Default `progress`. Report a seek as `seek`, or the jump counts as time watched.

name.description: The item's name, when the client has it; otherwise Multitap looks the meta up.

matchBonus.description: The candidate's `bingeGroup` equals the request's `preferBingeGroup` (the release the previous episode played). Strong, but below the mismatch penalties, and it never makes an unplayable candidate playable.

otherPenalty.description: Anything but MKV/MP4 (and MPEG-TS once prepared).

uncachedPenalty.description: Subtracted from a debrid source the addon marks as not cached (`parsed.cached: false`: Torrentio's `[RD download]`, MediaFusion's ⏳). It still plays, after the debrid service fetches it, so it ranks below healthy cached and torrent sources but is not excluded.

noTonemapPenalty.description: HDR on an engine without tone mapping.

tonemapCostLive.description: Tone mapping CPU cost, live sessions.

tonemapCostPrepared.description: Tone mapping CPU cost, prepared sessions.

dvUnknownProfilePenalty.description: Dolby Vision with no stated profile (might be profile 5).

matchBonus.description: The first preferred audio language is present.

secondaryMatchBonus.description: Not the first preferred language, but a later one in the request's list is present.

mismatchPenalty.description: Languages are known and none of the preferred ones is among them.

matchBonus.description: The candidate is the source the request's profile last played for this video (`lastUsed`). Above any tier difference, and with `binge.matchBonus` still below the episode mismatch penalty; it never makes an unplayable candidate playable.

episodeMismatchPenalty.description: Same show, another episode (rule 7): below every matching playable candidate.

unknownPoints.description: Height unknown (usually an old SD release).

titlePatterns.description: Plain phrases, not regular expressions, matched case-insensitively as whole words against a catalog item's or meta's name and a source's name and description. A match flags the item or source `destructive`: auto-select never picks it.

idPrefixes.description: Item ids starting with one of these (case-sensitive) are flagged `destructive`, and so is every source listed for them.

RankingSafety.description: Some addons list actions as items (a debrid account's `delete all files` entry). Flagged items and sources are annotated (`flags`), never auto-selected; an explicitly picked one still plays.

RankingSettingsInput.description: A complete `RankingSettings` document. `binge`, `lastSource`, `debrid` and `safety` may be left out (older presets): they take the defaults.

http.description: Plain HTTP (direct links), YouTube, live channels.

healthyTorrent.description: A torrent with at least `healthySeeders` seeders.

weakTorrent.description: A torrent with few or unknown seeders.

ids.description: Every addon id in the collection, exactly once, in the new order.

points.description: Signed: negative lowered the score. Zero moves are left out.

detail.description: Short non-secret note (parsed values only, never stream fields or URLs).

sources.description: One entry per searched catalog, in collection order (each addon in its manifest order). A catalog that failed is listed with its status and no results.

skip.description: The `skip` this catalog was asked with. For its next page ask again with `skip` plus `metas.length`.

videoId.description: The video id, for an episode.

maxHeight.description: Tallest output, in pixels. Capped at the engine's `liveMaxHeight`.

bitrate.description: Video bitrate in bits per second. Capped at `MULTITAP_SESSION_MAX_BITRATE`. A request with `maxHeight` and no `bitrate` gets one derived from the height (`MULTITAP_SESSION_BITRATE_BY_HEIGHT`, at most the engine's `defaultBitrate`), and a session's `quality` shows it.

addons.description: Every addon that was asked, in collection order.

id.description: Multitap's id for the file; stable while it's cached.

lang.description: As the addon gave it, usually ISO 639-2.

path.description: Relative to the media base: load it as `/media/{token}/{path}` with the same token, e.g. from a `<track crossorigin>`.

offsetMs.description: The session's timing offset for this track, applied by the media listener to every viewer (`PUT /v1/sessions/{id}/subtitles/{fileId}/offset`); 0 when none is set. A request's own `?offsetMs=` is added on top.

maxMbPerMinute.description: Above this is too large to fetch live.

key.description: Stable id for this stream within Multitap (a hash of the addon id and the source fields). Pass it back to play the stream.

name.description: The stream's short label, as the addon gave it.

title.description: The stream's description, as the addon gave it.

requiresEngine.description: Only this engine can play it (engine-local content).

score.description: Rank for the target engine; higher is better.

playableWhen.description: `prepared`: needs a full or scheduled preparation first.

bingeGroup.description: The addon's `behaviorHints.bingeGroup`: streams of one release share it across episodes. Pass a session's `bingeGroup` back as `preferBingeGroup` to keep the release for the next episode.

lastUsed.description: Present (true) when the list was asked for a profile (`profileId`) and this is the source the profile last played for this video (its `key` equals the profile's `lastSource.sourceIdentity`). Ranked up by `lastSource.matchBonus`.

contributions.description: In the order applied. Their points sum exactly to `score`.

weights.description: The ranking settings behind the rules that applied, by name (`tiers.http`, `binge.matchBonus`, ...).

playability.description: The playability verdict (rule 1) that goes with the score.

detail.description: What matched: the pattern, and whether it was the source or its item. Never stream fields or URLs.

flags.description: Why the candidate carries `flags` (the setting that matched). Flags never change the score; they keep the candidate out of auto-select.

explain.description: The rules behind `score` and `playable`. Only with `explain=true`.

engine.description: The engine candidates were ranked for.

candidates.description: `sort=addon`: grouped in collection order, each addon in its own order. `sort=rank`: playable first, then by score. Nothing is hidden.

addons.description: Every addon that was asked, in collection order.

requestId.description: Identifies this list's `streams.partial` events; follow them with `GET /v1/events?request={requestId}`, which replays the ones already sent.

engine.description: The engine candidates are ranked for.

get.description: Messages carry `id`, `event` (the type) and `data` (the event as JSON; the `MultitapEvent` schema). On reconnect, `Last-Event-ID` replays missed events from a bounded buffer; the `X-Events-Replay` header says `complete`, or `partial` when some were lost (re-read session state then). post.description: Plays a picked source (`source: {key}`, a candidate key from `/v1/streams`; no fallback) or lets Multitap choose (`source: {auto: true}`: rank for the engine, try the playable candidates in order, stop after `MULTITAP_AUTO_SELECT_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, retry a failed torrent once after `MULTITAP_AUTO_SELECT_RETRY_AFTER_MS`). The engine is the candidate's affinity, else `engine`, else the default. `quality` is capped at the engine's `liveMaxHeight` and `MULTITAP_SESSION_MAX_BITRATE`; with `maxHeight` and no `bitrate`, Multitap derives a bitrate from the height (`MULTITAP_SESSION_BITRATE_BY_HEIGHT`). The resulting quality is part of the session's identity. Auto-select abandons a candidate that isn't ready within `MULTITAP_AUTO_SELECT_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS`. The answer comes at once with `status: 'resolving'`; follow `session.status`, `session.ready` and `session.failed` on `/v1/events?session={id}`, or poll the session. With a `key`, a create matching the key, item, source, delivery and quality of an open session returns that session with `200`. A new session on an engine already at its `liveConcurrency` is logged, or with `MULTITAP_ENGINE_ADMISSION=reject` refused with `503` and `Retry-After`.

get.description: Every stream every matching addon returned, as candidates annotated for an engine. `sort=addon` (default) keeps collection order and each addon's own order; `sort=rank` orders playable candidates first, then by score. Nothing is hidden. Answers once every addon has answered or timed out. With `incremental=true` it answers `202` at once with a request id, and each addon's candidates follow as a `streams.partial` event (`GET /v1/events?request={requestId}`), in answer order, the last with `remaining: 0`; `sort=rank` then orders each event's candidates.
